issues.jp_before: 会社[かいしゃ]{の|no-possessive}人[ひと]{に|ni-target}道[みち]{を|o-object}聞[き]きました。
issues.problem: Distractor で gives 道で聞きました ('asked on the street'), a grammatical sentence that is too close; English 'asked ... the way' was awkward.
issues.action: Replaced distractor で with と; English changed to 'I asked someone from the company for directions.'

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{は/が|wa-topic}書類[しょるい]{に|ni-location}はんこ{を|o-object}押[お]しました。
issues.problem: Distractor で (はんこで押しました, 'stamped with a seal') is borderline acceptable with the same English.
issues.action: Replaced distractor で with と.

issues.jp_before: 昼[ひる]ご飯[はん]{の|no-possessive}あと、コーヒー{を|o-object}飲[の]みました。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of line 14 (コーヒーを飲みました).
issues.action: Rewrote as 昼ご飯のあと、お茶を入れました。 'After lunch I made some tea.'

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{の|no-possessive}日[ひ]{は|wa-topic}傘[かさ]{を|o-object}持[も]ちます。
issues.problem: 傘を持ちます as a habit ('carry an umbrella') is unnatural; natives say 持って行きます.
issues.action: Rewrote as 雨の日は長靴をはきます。 'On rainy days I wear rain boots.' (lv 3).
